note: Play in stage order. Stage 1 banks every missable trophy while the story is still open; stages 2 to 4 sweep the rest; stage 5 is the 100% cleanup and the platinum.

stages.missableWarning: Do not rush past these five: Baited My Tackle (beat Cal when the fishing challenge appears), Catch Me If You Can (the unscheduled departure at VCIA), Personal Best (the big partnership moment), Actions Speak Louder (take the choices the story offers), The Truth Is Out There (the strange event somewhere in Leonida).
stages.summary: Play the whole campaign in order and bank the missable moments as they appear. The chapter trophies and the mission trophies land on their own; the five flagged missables need you to act in the moment.
stages.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale

stages.missableWarning: None of the strand finales are missable once the strand is open, so take them at your own pace.
stages.summary: Between and after story chapters, finish the stranger strands. Eight completed strands earn the silver, and each strand finale is its own bronze.
stages.title: Strangers and side strands

stages.missableWarning: No collectible is missable; every spot stays open after the story ends.
stages.summary: Sweep Leonida district by district: 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored, all 18 meditation spots, and all 8 garage properties. Pair the sweeps so one drive covers three counts at once.
stages.title: Collectibles sweep — cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas

stages.missableWarning: None of these are missable in free roam; save the long grinds for after the story so the map is fully open.
stages.summary: Work the activity families: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, drone race wins at all 14 spots, 20 different race wins, 50 challenges, the partner jobs, the robberies, the money goals and the Scooter Bros registrations.
stages.title: Activities and grinds

stages.missableWarning: If a missable trophy is still locked, it needs a new playthrough — check the tracker before you finish the story.
stages.summary: Check the tracker for anything still open, finish the last counts, and reach 100% completion for the gold. The platinum unlocks the moment the 54th other trophy pops.
stages.title: Cleanup and platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
